title: The derived extension of scalars $T_{E,\Qlb}$
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $X$ a scheme and $E$ a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$.
The derived extension of scalars

$$
T_{E,\Qlb}=\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{E_X}-=L(\operatorname{Ext}_{E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}})\colon
D(\Mod_{E_X})\longrightarrow D(\Mod_{\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}})
$$

is the derived extension of scalars of [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars] along the
inclusion $E_X\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$ of [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map].

Here $\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ denotes the category of module objects in
$\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$ of [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and $D$ denotes the
unbounded derived category of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Equivalently, this is the
functor $T^X$ of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change] for the condensed inclusion
$\underline E\to\underline{\Qlb}$.

lean.statement:
noncomputable abbrev derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl (E : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) :
    DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicAlgClRingObj X ℓ)) :=
lean.note: Exact existing derived scalar-extension functor in the published pro-etale framework, with enclosing parameters (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]. Its source and target are the unbounded derived categories of internal modules over the specified pulled-back coefficient rings. The current server source abbreviates finiteCoefficientDerivedToAlgCl X ℓ E from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.CondensedDerivedTensorComparison; that reducible definition is exactly (Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl X ℓ E)).leftDerivedFunctor. Thus it is definitionally the displayed L(Ext) along the recorded condensed inclusion, with no additional hypotheses. The older local framework spells the same body directly as L(Mod.extendScalars ...). No new module or definition is introduced.
